stub.section: Town of Mill Creek to Highway 99

pointOfInterests.description: Ponderosa Way is a dirt road that crosses the creek, providing the only easy access over this distance.  This road can be used to divide the creek into an upper and lower run.
pointOfInterests.name: Ponderosa Way
